name: Nitin Castings Limited
about: Nitin Castings Limited manufactures, sells, and exports alloy steel castings in India and internationally. It offers centrifugal, sand, shell-molded, and investment castings. The company was formerly known as Nitin Alloys Global Limited and changed its name to Nitin Castings Limited in October 2016. Nitin Castings Limited was founded in 1964 and is based in Mumbai, India.
